text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The Classic Triple Crown, Leg 3: The Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Here, Pokke.
Your outfit is all ready to go.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Th-Thanks... This is unreal.
Having Fuji-san fix up my outfit and all...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
At least let me do this much for you.
You are, after all, the star actor who stepped onto the stage of my dreams.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: And... with the "running style closest to my own", no less.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
The closest running style...
Though earlier, they said her leg strength and such were close to Tachyon's too...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fate may indeed be that way.
However, your running form is closer to it.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer-san?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Wha-, seriously? Explain it to me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon leans slightly backward, utilizing a form that emphasizes extension. On the other hand—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Both Fuji Kiseki and Jungle Pocket lean forward
and dig hard into the turf.
From a Trainer's perspective, that much is crystal clear.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Then seriously, I'm the one who...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Pokke, in our world...
there's something more important than fate.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You, who looked up to me. And Trainer-san, who wished
to avenge my brother's regrets.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Those two things together are what gave birth to your running style today.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"'Oh, little birds, take flight!
You who gaze up at the sky with the most passionate eyes are the true offspring!'"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The bond between you and me
is unshakeable, Pokke.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Fuji-san... Fuji... s...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: W-W-WOOOOAAAHH!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I'll show them, today.
The culmination... of my feelings.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
The final leg of the Classic Triple Crown.
This is a race of closure dedicated to Fuji-san.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: My greatest rival is, of course—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Pokke-chan, sorry to keep you waiting!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Today is a big match for me too!
A huge one.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, if anyone's gonna beat me, it's you, Dants.
—Come at me!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'll show my strength here,
and keep giving it my all with Pokke-chan from here on out!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Races like the Arima Kinen, or the Tenno Sho (Spring)...
On and on, forever and ever...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Will it be Jungle Pocket, or Dantsu Flame?
In terms of the race, it's down to these two powerhouses."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: This was supposed to be a showdown between the top two, but...
choice_data_list: I just can't shake this feeling...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An unexpected factor... I couldn't shake the feeling
that a dark horse unnoticed by everyone was lurking.
